ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 4:1 ratio of white (high-intensity) to black (low-intensity) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white intensity on the lateral lobes; low-intensity black pixels form a central vertical 'anchor' or 'T' shape extending from the peduncle to the median notch, with secondary black clusters at the distal tips and along the trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 135 degrees and a shallow vertical depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire trailing edge; the left lobe shows higher amplitude irregularities and small notches compared to the right lobe's more continuous contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the center; leading edges (superior boundary) exhibit moderate convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters observed primarily along the perimeter of the trailing edge and at the distal tips, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal dark linear marks (rake-like disruptions) located on the mid-right lobe; smaller, horizontal linear marks present on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Hook-shaped irregularity on the left distal tip and significant marginal pixel erosion along the trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique anchor-shaped central pigmentation pattern with high symmetry.
